title: ExplainDataAccessConsentScope
description: A single consent scope that provides info on who has access to the requested resource scope for a particular purpose and environment, enforced by which consent.

decision.description: Whether the current consent scope is permitted or denied access on the requested resource.

enforcingConsents.description: Metadata of the consent resources that enforce the consent scope's access.

exceptions.description: Other consent scopes that created exceptions within this scope.
